description:
Market and event reads. what: 'tape' (the reserve's price, supply,
    recent swaps), 'pools' (holdings, swaps, fees; `limit` = days),
    'holders' (`limit` = top N), 'ticker' (default; events as one-liners),
    'pulse' (typed events; `kind` filters). Not advice; money never moves a
    meter number; events are not measurements.
name: wire
